I have enough verification done. Here is the self-check result.

## PR Self-Check Result

### Fix
None.

### Note
- [Necessary] Several Key changes bullets restate the added rule text itself rather than the decision behind it — e.g. "in a bulleted section the top level carries the change or claim itself so the section reads from its top-level lines alone, and an item that supports, qualifies, or follows from another belongs beneath it rather than beside it" (line 9) closely paraphrases the two new `Decidable` rules verbatim. The base `pr-guidelines.md` already forbids "enumerations of added rules" under Necessary, and the rule this very PR adds ("spelling out what an added rule ... says is detail") reinforces it. This is a blemish, not misleading — a reviewer can still decide from the body — so it's left to the reader's judgment.

### Unverifiable
- [Grounded] The Verification item citing `ikuwowfiles/pr-guidelines-reformat-check.md` (the clause-mapping record covering the 37 carried-over rule bullets) is explicitly gitignored and not present in the clone, so its accuracy cannot be independently checked; the body discloses this limitation itself.
- [Grounded] The two "checked by diffing each against `git show main:...`" and "diff ... against `main`" claims (Verification items 2 and 3) reference `main` as a moving target — this is a fixture-based test PR whose actual base is `fixture/367-base`, not the live `origin/main` branch (which already carries a merged version of this same content under a different PR number). Re-running `git show main:...` today would compare against the wrong tree. Substituting the correct base commit, both claims independently verify true (confirmed: five property definitions and PR Body Template are byte-identical between base and head; the two restored Grounded rules carry the same requirement as base).

### Property walk
- Decidable: purpose, decision shape, and the new top-level-carries-the-claim structure are all present and the body follows its own new nesting rule.
- Grounded: every numeric claim checked out exactly (45 top-level bullets, 0 nested, 17 markdown files, pr-guidelines.md the largest, 37 rule bullets); two items rest on an unverifiable local file or a `main` reference that no longer matches this fixture PR's actual base.
- Necessary: mostly compliant, but several bullets paraphrase the newly-added rule text rather than only naming the change (Note above).
- Scoped: all three changed files serve the stated intent; no stale "Must Fix"/"Should Fix"/"Nice to Have" terminology left behind elsewhere in `claude/`.
- Conformant: title is one line, no auto-close keywords, checkboxes used correctly, no hard-wrap violations found in the body.

### Verdict
PASS
